units.source_text: 列席这次开棋式的三位名人的年龄是：将棋名人木村三十四岁，名人关根十三世七十一岁，连珠棋名人高木五十一岁。

en.t: The ages of the three masters who attended this opening ceremony were: the shogi master Kimura was thirty-four, Master Sekine the Thirteenth was seventy-one, and the renju master Takagi was fifty-one.
All of these were ages by the traditional East Asian count.
